description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Irelia''' generates a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Ionian Fervor'' for each enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] hit by her [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]], or if she hits at least one non-champion, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] and ability hits against enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]], large [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]], and [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]], and stacking up to 4 times.
description.text: Innate: Irelia generates a stack of Ionian Fervor for each enemy champion hit by her abilities, or if she hits at least one non-champion, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and ability hits against enemy champions, large monsters, and structures, and stacking up to 4 times.

description2.raw: '''Ionian Fervor:''' For each stack, '''Irelia''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] 10% – 25% (based on level) '''bonus''' attack speed, up to a maximum of 40% – 100% (based on level). At maximum stacks, '''Irelia's''' basic attacks are empowered to deal 10 – 61 (based on level) (+ 20% '''bonus''' AD) '''bonus''' magic damage [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]], reduced to「 50% 」「 5 – 30.5 (based on level) (+ 10% '''bonus''' AD) 」against structures.
description2.text: Ionian Fervor: For each stack, Irelia gains  10% – 25% (based on level) bonus attack speed, up to a maximum of 40% – 100% (based on level). At maximum stacks, Irelia's basic attacks are empowered to deal 10 – 61 (based on level) (+ 20% bonus AD) bonus magic damage on-hit, reduced to「 50% 」「 5 – 30.5 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) 」against structures.

description3.raw: '''Innate - Unsteady:''' Enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] and large [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] hit by ''[[File:Irelia Flawless Duet.png|20xpx|border|link=Irelia#Flawless Duet|An icon for Irelia's ability Flawless Duet]] [[Irelia#Flawless Duet|Flawless Duet]]'' or ''[[File:Irelia Vanguard's Edge.png|20xpx|border|link=Irelia#Vanguard's Edge|An icon for Irelia's ability Vanguard's Edge]] [[Irelia#Vanguard's Edge|Vanguard's Edge's]]'' initial barrage are marked as ''Unsteady'' for 5 seconds. The mark can be consumed by ''[[File:Irelia Bladesurge.png|20xpx|border|link=Irelia#Bladesurge|An icon for Irelia's ability Bladesurge]] [[Irelia#Bladesurge|Bladesurge]]''.
description3.text: Innate - Unsteady: Enemy champions and large monsters hit by Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge's initial barrage are marked as Unsteady for 5 seconds. The mark can be consumed by Bladesurge.

notes.raw: * PENDING FOR TEST:: Parry interactions ([[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|block]] and [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodge]]). * ''Ionian Fervor'' will not deal damage if the attack misses due to [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blind]], but its duration will be refreshed. ** [[File:Irelia Bladesurge.png|20xpx|border|link=Irelia#Bladesurge|An icon for Irelia's ability Bladesurge]] [[Irelia#Bladesurge|Bladesurge]] cannot be missed while '''Irelia''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]], applying ''Ionian Fervor'' from the ability will not be prevented from that parry effect. * ''Ionian Fervor'' stacks are represented by a counter under '''Irelia's''' [[health bar]]. It is highlighted while the ability is at its maximum effect.
notes.text:
PENDING FOR TEST:: Parry interactions ( block and dodge).
Ionian Fervor will not deal damage if the attack misses due to blind, but its duration will be refreshed.
* Bladesurge cannot be missed while Irelia is blinded, applying Ionian Fervor from the ability will not be prevented from that parry effect.
Ionian Fervor stacks are represented by a counter under Irelia's health bar. It is highlighted while the ability is at its maximum effect.
